Based on my search, here's what I found about watching MSNBC (now rebranded as **MS NOW**) live streaming online:

## Important Note: MSNBC Has Rebranded to MS NOW

MSNBC was **rebranded to "MS NOW"** in November 2025 as part of Comcast's spin-off into a new entity called Versant. The name stands for **"My Source for News, Opinion, and the World."** The same programming, hosts, and content continue under the new name, but the NBC peacock logo and "NBC" reference have been dropped.

## Free Streaming Options

### Official Free Options (Limited)
- **Peacock** (www.peacock.com) - NBCUniversal's streaming service offers some MSNBC/MS NOW content. The free tier has limited content, while Peacock Premium provides more access.

### Third-Party Free Streaming Sites
Several websites claim to offer free MSNBC/MS NOW live streams without requiring a cable login:

| Site | URL | Notes |
|------|-----|-------|
| Live News Chat | livenewschat.eu | Claims 24/7 HD streaming, no signup required |
| US News On | usnewson.com | Claims free HD streaming |
| Live News Time | livenewstime.com | Offers free stream with optional premium HD service |
| NewsLive.com | newslive.com | Claims free worldwide access |

## Paid Streaming Services with Free Trials

If you want legitimate, reliable access, these services carry MSNBC/MS NOW and typically offer free trials:

- **YouTube TV**
- **Hulu + Live TV** (~$54.99/month)
- **Sling TV** (offers MSNBC in some packages)
- **fuboTV**
- **DIRECTV Stream**

## Important Considerations

⚠️ **Be cautious with "free" streaming sites** - Many unofficial free streaming sites operate in legal gray areas and may:
- Contain malware or excessive ads
- Have unreliable streams
- Violate copyright laws
- Collect your data

For the most reliable and legal experience, consider using the **official Peacock service** or signing up for a **free trial** with a legitimate live TV streaming service like Sling TV or Hulu + Live TV, then canceling before the trial period ends if you don't want to continue.
